“Before the ego cogito there is an ego conquiro; “I conquer” is…” — Enrique Dussel (Q0670)

An English quotation associated with Philosophy of Liberation §1.1.2.2 (Martínez), organized here under time.

Quotes / Enrique Dussel / Q0670

English

Before the ego cogito there is an ego conquiro; “I conquer” is the practical foundation of “I think.”
Thinker Enrique Dussel
School Political Phenomenology
Source Philosophy of Liberation §1.1.2.2 (Martínez)

Source context

Archive record: this English passage is associated with Philosophy of Liberation §1.1.2.2 (Martínez), within the Political Phenomenology tradition. Use the cited work or edition when a scholarly attribution is needed.

A short reading

Read in the register of time, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Enrique Dussel's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
